# Steam Community
> Steam Community is Valve’s social platform for player profiles, game hubs, discussions, guides, screenshots, videos, Workshop items, and the Community Market.

Steam Community connects Steam users with game-specific community spaces and account-level social features. It hosts user-generated content, item trading, group discussions, reviews, broadcasts, and developer-facing Workshop documentation.

## Core Community
- [Steam Community Home](https://steamcommunity.com/): Main entry point for profiles, game hubs, activity, and community features.
- [Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions): Central directory for Steam-wide and game-specific discussion forums.
- [Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/): Browse Steam Workshop hubs for mods, items, and other user-created content.
- [Market](https://steamcommunity.com/market/): Community Market for buying and selling eligible Steam items.
- [Greenlight](https://steamcommunity.com/greenlight/): Archived Steam Greenlight community area and historical submission pages.
- [Broadcasts](https://steamcommunity.com/?subsection=broadcasts): Community broadcasts surfaced through the Steam Community homepage.

## Profiles, Social, and Identity
- [My Profile](https://steamcommunity.com/my/): Shortcut to the signed-in user’s Steam Community profile.
- [Friends](https://steamcommunity.com/my/friends/): Manage friends, friend activity, and social connections.
- [Groups](https://steamcommunity.com/my/groups/): View and manage Steam groups the user belongs to.
- [Inventory](https://steamcommunity.com/my/inventory/): Access tradable items, game inventories, and marketable assets.
- [Screenshots](https://steamcommunity.com/my/screenshots/): Personal screenshot gallery shared through Steam Community.
- [Videos](https://steamcommunity.com/my/videos/): Personal video uploads and linked video content.
- [Workshop Files](https://steamcommunity.com/my/sharedfiles/): User-published Workshop items and other shared files.
- [Edit Profile](https://steamcommunity.com/my/edit): Profile customization, privacy, avatar, and account presentation settings.

## Game Hubs and Store-Linked Community Pages
- [Game Hub Directory](https://steamcommunity.com/app/): Base path used for game-specific community hubs.
- [Counter-Strike 2 Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/730): Community hub for Counter-Strike 2 discussions, guides, and Workshop content.
- [Dota 2 Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/570): Community hub for Dota 2 media, discussions, and user guides.
- [Team Fortress 2 Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/440): Community hub for Team Fortress 2 items, Workshop, and discussions.
- [PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/578080): Community hub for PUBG discussions, screenshots, and guides.
- [Wallpaper Engine Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/431960): Community hub centered on Workshop content and user creations.
- [Garry's Mod Hub](https://steamcommunity.com/app/4000): Community hub for Garry’s Mod addons, discussions, and screenshots.

## User-Generated Content
- [Shared Files](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/): Entry point for shared Workshop items, guides, and community uploads.
- [Browse Shared Files](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/browse/): Browse community-created files across supported content types.
- [Guides](https://steamcommunity.com/app/765/guides/): Steam Guides hub for player-written tutorials and walkthroughs.
- [Artwork](https://steamcommunity.com/my/images/): Personal artwork gallery shared on Steam Community.
- [Workshop Browse](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/): Browse Workshop items by app, tags, popularity, and recency.
- [Workshop Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/): Discussion area for Workshop creators and subscribers.

## Community Market and Trading
- [Community Market Home](https://steamcommunity.com/market/): Overview of market listings, prices, and item categories.
- [Market Search](https://steamcommunity.com/market/search): Search market listings across games and item types.
- [My Market Listings](https://steamcommunity.com/market/): Signed-in access point for active listings and market history.
- [Trade Offers](https://steamcommunity.com/my/tradeoffers/): Manage incoming, outgoing, and historical Steam trade offers.
- [Badges](https://steamcommunity.com/my/badges/): View badges, trading card progress, and crafting-related rewards.
- [Inventory](https://steamcommunity.com/my/inventory/): Inventory management for items used in trades and market listings.

## Discussions and Community Forums
- [Steam Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/): Top-level forum index for Steam and game communities.
- [General Discussions](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/1/): Steam-wide general discussion forum.
- [Help and Tips](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/1/): Steam discussion area commonly used for support and advice.
- [Off Topic](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/12/): Community off-topic forum for non-product discussion.
- [Suggestions / Ideas](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/10/): Forum for Steam feature suggestions and community feedback.
- [Hardware and Operating Systems](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/11/): Forum for hardware compatibility and OS-related discussion.

## Groups and Curators
- [Groups Directory](https://steamcommunity.com/search/groups): Search for public Steam Community groups.
- [Create Group](https://steamcommunity.com/actions/GroupCreate): Create a new Steam group.
- [Curators](https://steamcommunity.com/curators/): Browse Steam Curators and their recommendation pages.
- [Curator Groups](https://steamcommunity.com/curators/topcurators): Discover prominent curator accounts and recommendation sources.
- [Group Announcements](https://steamcommunity.com/gid/): Base path used for group pages and announcements.
- [Events](https://steamcommunity.com/my/eventcomments): User-facing entry point for event-related comments and activity.

## Workshop Documentation for Developers
- [Steam Workshop Documentation](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/about/): Overview of Steam Workshop concepts, integration, and publishing basics.
- [Workshop Implementation Guide](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/workshopimplementationguide): Technical guide for integrating Steam Workshop into a game.
- [Workshop Legal Agreement](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/workshoplegalagreement): Terms governing submission of Workshop content.
- [ISteamUGC Interface](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUGC): Steamworks API reference for Workshop and UGC integration.
- [Steamworks Documentation](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/home): Developer documentation for Steam platform and community-related APIs.
- [Steamworks Web API](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/webapi_overview): Overview of Steam Web API endpoints used by community-connected applications.

## Help and Policies
- [Steam Support](https://help.steampowered.com/): Official support portal for Steam accounts, purchases, and community issues.
- [Community Rules and Guidelines](https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/7/): Forum area commonly used for rules, moderation, and conduct references.
- [Privacy Policy](https://store.steampowered.com/privacy_agreement/): Valve privacy policy covering Steam and community services.
- [Steam Subscriber Agreement](https://store.steampowered.com/subscriber_agreement/): Terms of service governing Steam accounts and community usage.
- [Online Conduct Rules](https://store.steampowered.com/online_conduct/): Rules for behavior across Steam services and community spaces.
- [Content Reporting](https://help.steampowered.com/): Support entry point for reporting abusive or inappropriate community content.
